description: TAZ road selection configuration. Road filtering is area-aware, not globally fixed.

road_class_meaning.motorway: high-speed controlled access roads, usually excluded unless present as an operational corridor boundary
road_class_meaning.tertiary: local collector roads with meaningful traffic flow
road_class_meaning.residential: local streets, only promoted when needed for TAZ origin anchoring
road_class_meaning.service: parking, access, and low-impact internal roads, usually dropped

central_bengaluru.reason: Dense urban core needs primary and secondary movement, with tertiary roads retained to preserve reachability between compact blocks.

hsr_layout.reason: Structured grid area where collector roads such as main roads matter for commuter origins and local routing.

koramangala.reason: Mixed commercial and residential area where tertiary connectors are important for cross-area movement.

btm_layout.reason: Connector and residential area feeding Koramangala, Silk Board, and HSR movement.

bellandur.reason: IT corridor congestion is dominated by ORR-style trunk/primary movement and major collectors.

marathahalli.reason: Arterial congestion area with important trunk, primary, and collector interactions.

indiranagar.reason: Commercial plus residential area requiring collector roads for realistic access to demand anchors.

whitefield_edge.reason: Office-heavy extension represented at the edge, so through corridors and collectors matter more than micro streets.

silk_board_region.reason: Bottleneck area where trunk, primary, and collector links determine congestion propagation.

malleshwaram.reason: Traditional urban area where collector streets preserve realistic neighborhood entry and exit.

residential: Promote only when the edge is adjacent to apartment-heavy origin zones.
Promote only when it connects a TAZ centroid to the retained operational graph.
Do not promote dead-end residential micro roads unless needed for reachability validation.
tertiary: Keep when it links residential origins to primary or secondary roads.
Keep when it lies on a corridor between selected V1 areas.
Drop isolated tertiary fragments that do not improve graph connectivity.
service: Promote only for explicitly tagged transport hubs, hospitals, or large office campuses in a later version.
